title: Revenue OS
description: Unified deal operations platform for a B2B SaaS sales team.
longDescription: We replaced disconnected CRM workflows with a unified operations layer that made forecasting accurate and onboarding fast.
challenge: Sales and RevOps teams were working from inconsistent records, making forecasts noisy and handoffs slow.
solution: We implemented a workflow engine with guardrails for stage changes, automatic enrichment, and deal health scoring.

slides.title: Operational Baseline
slides.description: Mapped current sales workflow and identified the highest-friction handoffs.

slides.title: Workflow Design
slides.description: Designed state transitions and automation checkpoints by deal stage.

slides.title: Product Build
slides.description: Built the ops layer with strict validation, alerts, and analytics.

slides.title: Rollout
slides.description: Rolled out by team in waves with telemetry and feedback loops.

testimonial.quote: Forecast calls changed from debate to decisions.
testimonial.author: Anya Morris
